_comment: Fanmade Ultimatums & Refractions from FFG's 'Week of Arkham Horror 2026' Cultist Challenges document (player-submitted, NOT official FFG design). Injected into the Ultimatums/Boons/Refractions viewer by tools/ub_fanmade.py (a post-step mirroring ub_cap1.py), ENGLISH ONLY for now; other languages show them as pending via ub_merge. Each card carries an 'author' credit rendered as a bold, centred notice (i18n strings ubfanmade / ubfanmadeanon). chapter 'cc' = Cultist Challenges, a source distinct from cap1 (retired FAQ) and cap2 (2026 Grimoire): the viewer hides 'cc' from the Ch.1/Ch.2 cuts and shows it under 'All' and the campaign filter. Each slug must also exist in assets/ub/index.json (added as a noart placeholder by import_ub_cards.py) or the card is silently dropped. NOTE the two 'Ultimatum of Blood Frenzy' are DIFFERENT cards (distinct slugs); their names carry a (campaign)/(scenario) suffix so they can be told apart.

runs.t: Each investigator that controls more than 1
clues gets –2 sanity.
When you draw a signature weakness, reveal it and take 1 horror.
Each time an investigator reveals, cancels, or ignores an autofail token, that investigator takes 1 damage or 1 horror.
Whenever you seal a
token on your investigator, also take a direct damage.
Whenever a
Civilian
enemy is defeated, each investigator takes a direct horror and a mental trauma.
The first time a
Monster
enemy attacks you each round, if you have a
token sealed on your investigator: Release a
token and the enemy attacks you an additional time.
Treat the modifier of each revealed
token as –2 instead of –1.
In addition to their normal effect,
tokens gain the following effect: “If another
token is revealed from the chaos bag during the same test, immediately end the ‘reveal chaos tokens’ step of the skill test and resolve the test as an automatic failure.”

The residents of Arkham aren’t cooperative with the investigator’s attempts to keep them out of harm’s way. Based on the difficulty, replace one (Easy), two (Standard/Hard), or three (Expert) of the Waterfront Civilians with Bystanders from the Arkham Horror: The Card Game (2026) Core Set. When instructed to spawn a
Civilian
, draw one of the four civilians at random to spawn.
Each copy of Child of Blood gains surge. During Setup, also gather the three copies of Child of Blood from the Blood Money encounter set.
While a
Monster
enemy is at their location, Suspicious Guests and Priscilla Thomas can not be parlayed with.
